summary.headline: Mercury–Jupiter Squares and Oppositions
summary.text: Interpretation of squares and oppositions involving Mercury and Jupiter, predicting debates among scholars and jurists, forged proofs and fatwas, disputes in courts and religious institutions, commercial troubles, counterfeit currency, illness, winds, and timely rain. The passage also describes effects on marriages, women, weather, fabrics, jewels, livestock, and charitable activity.
